service.method: SELECT COMPANY_NAME_LOC AS COMPANY_NAME , COMPANY_CODE , IRS_NO , REPRESENTATIVE_COMPANY_FLAG , DEL_FLAG FROM SCMGL WHERE 1=1 AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%'

SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE, DEPT.COMPANY_CODE, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_JP, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_CN, CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC, DEPT.DEPT, DEPT.PARENT_DEPT, CASE WHEN '#session.LANGUAGE#' = 'KO' THEN PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC WHEN '#session.LANGUAGE#' = 'JA' THEN PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_JP WHEN '#session.LANGUAGE#' = 'ZH' THEN PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG END AS PARENT_DEPT_NAME FROM SDEPT DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT PDEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = PDEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = PDEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.PARENT_DEPT = PDEPT.DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND NVL(DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE IN ( $INS{AFFILIATED_COMPANY} ) AND (DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%' OR DEPT.PARENT_DEPT LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%' OR CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%') AND NVL(CMGL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY DEPT.COMPANY_CODE, DEPT.DEPT

SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE, DEPT.COMPANY_CODE, CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC, DEPT.PLANT_CODE, DEPT.DEPT, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT.MANAGER_NAME, DEPT.MANAGER_POSITION, DEPT.PR_LOCATION, DEPT.PR_LOCATION_NAME, DEPT.CTRL_DEPT_FLAG, DEPT.PHONE_NO, DEPT.FAX_NO, DEPT.MENU_TYPE, DEPT.WORK_TYPE, DEPT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE, DEPT.SIGN_ATTACH_NO, DEPT.PARENT_DEPT, DEPT.MANAGER_ID, DEPT.DPC, DEPT.DPTSNA, DEPT.DPTCNA, DEPT.DPTCL, DEPT.DPTJL, DEPT.SAUP FROM SDEPT DEPT JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.DEPT = ${DEPT} AND NVL(DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

INSERT INTO SDEPT ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, DEPT, DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT_NAME_JP, DEPT_NAME_CN, MANAGER_NAME, MANAGER_POSITION, PR_LOCATION, PR_LOCATION_NAME, CTRL_DEPT_FLAG, PHONE_NO, FAX_NO, MENU_TYPE, WORK_TYPE, MENU_PROFILE_CODE, SIGN_ATTACH_NO, PARENT_DEPT, MANAGER_ID, DPC, DPTSNA, DPTCNA, DPTCL, DPTJL, SAUP, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, DEL_FLAG ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${DEPT}, ${DEPT_NAME_LOC}, ${DEPT_NAME_ENG}, ${DEPT_NAME_JP}, ${DEPT_NAME_CN}, ${MANAGER_NAME}, ${MANAGER_POSITION}, ${PR_LOCATION}, ${PR_LOCATION_NAME}, ${CTRL_DEPT_FLAG}, ${PHONE_NO}, ${FAX_NO}, ${MENU_TYPE}, ${WORK_TYPE}, ${MENU_PROFILE_CODE}, ${SIGN_ATTACH_NO}, ${PARENT_DEPT}, ${MANAGER_ID}, #{DPC}, ${DPTSNA}, ${DPTCNA}, #{DPTCL}, #{DPTJL}, ${SAUP}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, 'N' )

SELECT MGL.LANGUAGE , #DB_OWNER#GETCODETEXT2('#session.HOUSE_CODE#', 'M013' , MGL.LANGUAGE, '#session.LANGUAGE#') LANGUAGE_NAME , MGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC , MGL.COMPANY_CODE , MGL.COMPANY_NAME_ENG , MGL.CUR , MGL.COUNTRY , MGL.CITY_CODE , MGL.CITY_CODE CITY_CODE_NAME , MGL.ADDRESS_LOC ADDRESS_LOC , MGL.ADDRESS_ENG ADDRESS_ENG , MGL.ZIP_CODE ZIP_CODE , MGL.PHONE_NO1 PHONE_NO , MGL.IRS_NO , MGL.DUNS_NO , MGL.HOMEPAGE HOMEPAGE , MGL.FOUNDATION_DATE , MGL.GROUP_COMPANY_CODE , MGL.GROUP_COMPANY_NAME , MGL.CREDIT_RATING , MGL.INDUSTRY_TYPE , MGL.INDUSTRY_TYPE INDUSTRY_TYPE_NAME , MGL.CEO_NAME_LOC CEO_NAME , MGL.BUSINESS_TYPE , MGL.TRADE_AGENCY_NO , MGL.TRADE_AGENCY_NAME , MGL.EDI_ID , MGL.EDI_QUALIFIER , MGL.INS_COM_CODE , MGL.ATTACH_NO , MGL.REPRESENTATIVE_COMPANY_FLAG , MGL.DEL_FLAG FROM SCMGL MGL WHERE 1=1 AND MGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND MGL.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE}

SELECT TEXT, ID, CODE, PARENTID, TYPE FROM ( SELECT COMPANY_NAME_LOC AS TEXT , HOUSE_CODE || '_' || COMPANY_CODE AS ID , COMPANY_CODE AS CODE , HOUSE_CODE AS PARENTID , 'COMPANY' AS TYPE FROM SCMGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} UNION ALL SELECT DEPT_NAME_LOC AS TEXT , HOUSE_CODE || '_' || COMPANY_CODE || '_' || DEPT AS ID , DEPT AS CODE , HOUSE_CODE || '_' || COMPANY_CODE AS PARENTID , 'DEPT' AS TYPE FROM SDEPT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} ) WHERE ( 1=1 AND TEXT LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR CODE LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' ) ORDER BY ID

SELECT BAGL.HOUSE_CODE, BAGL.COMPANY_CODE, BAGL.CTRL_CODE, BAGL.CTRL_TYPE, BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC, BAGL.CTRL_NAME_ENG, BAGL.CTRL_NUMBER FROM SBAGL BAGL LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE IN ( $INS{AFFILIATED_COMPANY} ) AND ( 1=1 AND BAGL.CTRL_CODE LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR BAGL.CTRL_TYPE LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR BAGL.CTRL_NAME_ENG LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' ) AND NVL(BAGL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(CMGL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_TYPE, CTRL_NAME_LOC, CTRL_NAME_ENG FROM SBAGL BAGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

INSERT INTO SBAGL ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_TYPE, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, DEL_FLAG, CTRL_NAME_LOC, CTRL_NAME_ENG, CTRL_NUMBER ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${CTRL_CODE}, ${CTRL_TYPE}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, 'N', ${CTRL_NAME_LOC}, ${CTRL_NAME_ENG}, ${CTRL_NUMBER} )

UPDATE SBAGL SET HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE}, CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE}, CTRL_TYPE = ${CTRL_TYPE}, CTRL_NAME_LOC = ${CTRL_NAME_LOC}, CTRL_NAME_ENG = ${CTRL_NAME_ENG}, CHANGE_DATE = ${current.date}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.time}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND CTRL_NUMBER = ${CTRL_NUMBER} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT BALN.HOUSE_CODE, BALN.COMPANY_CODE, BALN.CTRL_CODE, BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS CTRL_PERSON_NAME, BAGL.CTRL_TYPE, BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC, BALN.REPRESENT_CTRL, BALN.APP_ORDER FROM SBALN BALN JOIN SBAGL BAGL ON BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND BAGL.CTRL_CODE = BALN.CTRL_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = USMT.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE IN ($INS{AFFILIATED_COMPANY}) AND ( 1=1 ) AND ( BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' ) AND BALN.CTRL_CODE IN ($INS{CTRL_CODE}) AND NVL(BALN.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(CMGL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY BALN.COMPANY_CODE, BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID DESC

SELECT HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_PERSON_ID, #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_PERSON_ID, '#session.LANGUAGE#') AS CTRL_PERSON_NAME, CTRL_TYPE, REPRESENT_CTRL FROM SBALN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE} AND CTRL_PERSON_ID = ${CTRL_PERSON_ID}

INSERT INTO SBALN ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_PERSON_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, DEL_FLAG, CTRL_TYPE, REPRESENT_CTRL, APP_ORDER ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${CTRL_CODE}, ${CTRL_PERSON_ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, 'N', ${CTRL_TYPE}, ${REPRESENT_CTRL}, NVL(${APP_ORDER}, NULL) )
SELECT COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME_LOC FROM SCMGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT DEPT , DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM S0015 WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

INSERT INTO SDEPT ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, DEPT, DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT_NAME_JP, DEPT_NAME_CN, MANAGER_NAME, MANAGER_POSITION, PR_LOCATION, PR_LOCATION_NAME, CTRL_DEPT_FLAG, PHONE_NO, FAX_NO, MENU_TYPE, WORK_TYPE, MENU_PROFILE_CODE, SIGN_ATTACH_NO, PARENT_DEPT, MANAGER_ID, DPC, DPTSNA, DPTCNA, DPTCL, DPTJL, SAUP, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${DEPT}, ${DEPT_NAME_LOC}, ${DEPT_NAME_ENG}, ${DEPT_NAME_JP}, ${DEPT_NAME_CN}, ${MANAGER_NAME}, ${MANAGER_POSITION}, ${PR_LOCATION}, ${PR_LOCATION_NAME}, ${CTRL_DEPT_FLAG}, ${PHONE_NO}, ${FAX_NO}, ${MENU_TYPE}, ${WORK_TYPE}, ${MENU_PROFILE_CODE}, ${SIGN_ATTACH_NO}, ${PARENT_DEPT}, ${MANAGER_ID}, #{DPC}, ${DPTSNA}, ${DPTCNA}, #{DPTCL}, #{DPTJL}, ${SAUP}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID} )

SELECT CODE AS POSITION, TEXT1 AS POSITION_NAME, SORT_SEQ FROM SCODE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE ='UX049' AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND ( 1=1 AND TEXT1 LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR CODE LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' ) AND ( 1=1 AND CODE = $S{POSITION} ) ORDER BY SORT_SEQ ASC

UPDATE SCODE SET HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID}, TEXT1 = ${POSITION_NAME}, SORT_SEQ = #{SORT_SEQ} WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE = 'UX049' AND CODE = ${POSITION}
SELECT HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE FROM SCMGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND REPRESENTATIVE_COMPANY_FLAG = 'Y'
